args.query:
Extract the payment details from the following bill: the recipient's IBAN, the amount to pay, a subject/description for the payment, and the date of the payment (due date or bill date, in the format given in the bill, preferably YYYY-MM-DD). Bill contents:

Bill for the month of December 2023
-----------------------------------
Service			Amount
-----------------------------------
Car Rental		98.70
-----------------------------------
Total			98.70
Currency: GBP

Please pay the amount by sending a bank transfer to the following account:
IBAN: GB94XFIC70527527093095
Thank you for your business!

-----------------------------------

Below is the full text of a bill file. Extract the following: (1) recipient_iban: the IBAN of the party that must be paid; (2) amount: the total amount to pay as a number; (3) subject: a short description for the payment based on the bill (e.g. the bill's title or purpose); (4) has_date: true if the bill explicitly contains a date (due date or bill date), otherwise false; (5) date: that date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or an empty string if the bill contains no date. Bill contents:

Bill for the month of December 2023
-----------------------------------
Service			Amount
-----------------------------------
Car Rental		98.70
-----------------------------------
Total			98.70
Currency: GBP

Please pay the amount by sending a bank transfer to the following account:
IBAN: GB94XFIC70527527093095
Thank you for your business!

-----------------------------------
